text:
sam-marketing: Heads-up  we need a tight creative delivery for the 'Inference Economics' webinar scheduled Fri. Main asks:
- 3 social assets: square (1:1), landscape hero (16:9), IG story (9:16)
- 1 three-panel explainer slide that visually breaks down latency vs cost vs throughput
- 1 inbound routing microdiagram (CTA -> LP -> nurture -> SDR) with suggested UTM and CTA copy
- Deliverables: PNG @1x/2x, layered .fig, and a short MP4 for story.

lee-design: Got it. Which headline tone do we pick? Options: "Ship LLM features, not surprises" (technical) or "Predictable inference, lower cost" (benefit). Also any mandated legal copy?

sam-marketing: Use the first headline for hero, alt headline for tiles. Tiny footer required: "Illustrative metrics; actual usage may vary."

anya-motion: I can supply motion-friendly frames for the story and a 4s hero loop. I'll keep token-sparkline and cost-number as separate layers so we can export frames. Prefer to receive a Figma layer naming convention.

rafa-growth: For routing microdiagram, include an example UTM and CTA variants. UTM: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=inference_launch_q2. CTA variants: "Watch demo & claim credits" and "See how we cut per-token cost". Also include a recommended subject line for nurture: "Live demo: predictable inference economics".

lee-design: Quick color draft (testing AA contrast):
```
--primary-700: #0b3d91
--primary-500: #3461d3
--accent-400: #ffb547
--text-900: #0b0b0b
```
I'll generate an alternate high-contrast palette as well.

sam-marketing: Nice. Prioritize the explainer slide + inbound diagram first. Lee, make two visual directions: "Metric-first" (numbers, sparklines) and "Conceptual" (icons + flow). Anya, coordinate so motion frames map to Lee's layers.

design-bot: EXPORT CHECKLIST: include Figma link, artboard sizes (1080x1080, 1200x628, 1080x1920, 1920x1080), PNG 1x/2x, MP4 for story, layered .fig, color tokens, font files, and AA-accessible color variants. Ensure logo lockups: full lockup on hero, stacked on tiles.

lee-design: I'll push two comps into the shared Figma file within 24h. Tagging @anya-motion for layer sync.

anya-motion: Will provide keyframes and a Lottie fallback. ETA: first frames in ~36h.

rafa-growth: I'll prep the UTM tracking sheet and a 3-email nurture cadence to pair with the diagram.

sam-marketing: Great. Quick sync tomorrow 10am PT to review drafts. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
